blocks.text: MANDAUE CITY, Cebu — Mandaue City Sangguniang Kabataan (SK) Federation President Fleuritz Gayle Jumao-as is facing a complaint before the Office of the Ombudsman over alleged unpaid loans totaling P1.35 million for SK activities, including the Silhig Festival and The Outstanding Youth Award (TOYA). The complaint was filed by Wendell B. Basaca, a catering services business owner, who also named private individual Renato “Jay-R” Yosores Jr. as a respondent. In his affidavit-complaint dated Aug. 17, 2026, Basaca alleged that the respondents failed to repay money he had lent to finance activities organized by the SK.
